transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. I'm here to help you. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because I've been struggling with severe mood swings over the past several months. I go from periods of feeling extremely high and energetic, to times where I feel deeply depressed and completely empty. It has just been really difficult to handle these extreme ups and downs.

During those periods when you feel extremely high and energetic, have you ever required hospitalization, or did your symptoms ever become so severe that you were unable to function at work or in your daily life for at least a week?

No, I have never been hospitalized during those high periods. Even though I felt extremely energetic and active, I don't recall it ever being so severe that I couldn't function at work or manage my daily life.
